verdict.rationale: The pack contains no pricing documentation showing how costs behave as records and query volume grow. Serverless docs describe usage-based autoscaling with more resources allocated during spikes, but say nothing about cost caps, billing predictability, or the absence of per-request charges. Community comments call the licensing and SaaS pricing expensive, but no vendor claim of predictable pricing exists for them to contradict, so the verdict is none rather than disputed.
